Welcome to the companion website for the **ISPE 2026 Simulation Workshop**.

## About This Workshop

This workshop covers how to design, implement, and evaluate a Monte Carlo simulation study for a causal inference problem — using confounding by an unmeasured variable, inverse probability of treatment weighting (IPTW), and standard error estimation as a running example.

Topics include:

- The **ADEMP framework** (Aims, Data-generating mechanisms, Estimand, Methods, Performance measures) for planning a simulation study
- Building a data-generating mechanism (DGM) from a causal diagram, and deriving a "balancing intercept" so the DGM matches a target marginal outcome risk
- Scaling a single simulated sample up to thousands of replicates to study the sampling behavior of an estimator
- Comparing standard error estimators (model-based vs. sandwich/robust) by their confidence interval coverage

The workshop alternates between didactic sessions and hands-on activities. This site hosts the activity materials. Each activity page contains live, runnable R code powered by [webR](https://docs.r-wasm.org/webr/latest/) — no local R installation needed. When you load an activity page, the necessary packages download automatically in the background. Once ready, click **Run** on any code block to execute it directly in your browser.

## Materials

The code can be run directly in the browser from this website. If you'd prefer downloading files and running locally, each activity page has a **"Download the local version"** link at the top — a standard `.qmd` file with regular R chunks you can run in RStudio or with `quarto render`.

- [Activity 1](downloads/activity-1.qmd){download="activity-1.qmd"} — One random sample from the data-generating mechanism: bias estimation
- [Activity 2](downloads/activity-2.qmd){download="activity-2.qmd"} — One thousand random samples: sampling properties and SE estimation
- [Activity 3](downloads/activity-3.qmd){download="activity-3.qmd"} — Study planning (coming soon)

## How to Use This Site

Navigate using the sidebar on the left. Start with **Designing a Simulation Study** for background on the ADEMP framework and the running example. Then work through the **Activities** in order — each activity builds on the previous one.
